about_the_game:
Before The Coming End, Spotlight struggled to get taken seriously as a superhero.



One night, early in his career, Baron Beast opened portals across Edge City, releasing monsters of all kinds. While the Crusaders handle the beasts and the Baron, Spotlight dealt with crowd control. His attempt to save someone gets him caught in the maw of a hungry creature – one that’s interested in more than one of Spotlight’s holes.

But Spotlight’s night isn’t done. While monsters attack the city, a bank robbery is in progress, and there aren’t any heroes left to stop it. Spotlight stumbles upon a new super villain ready to take on Edge City: Psycock and his Techno Balls.

Enjoy two very NSFW comics (80+ pages total), filled with tentacles, bondage, milking, monsters, and more! Includes more than 400 images. Also comes with high-res, textless image packs, including images not used in the comic.



***

HOW TO ACCESS DLC FILES
DLC files found with in the game installation path
Once downloaded, you'll find this in the DLC of Fresh Force Frustrations in your Steam Library. Right-click the name of the game, click on Properties, then go to the Local Files tab, then click Browse Local Files. You'll find the DLC there.

Example file path: C:\Program Files (x86)\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\TheComingEndFreshForce
